title: Sunday · the bench
logline: A bench on the seawall, June, empty, the bay beyond. A plaque on it the strip won't letter. The place he'll sit in 2021 as a back.

panels.composition: Tier 1: a wooden bench on the seawall's walk in June, empty, the bay flat beyond, a gull on the wall.

image.prompt: an empty wooden bench on a seawall walk in June with a flat bay beyond and a gull on the wall, no words

panels.name: Bench

panels.composition: Tier 2: the bench's small brass plaque, close, its words rendered as worn shapes.

image.prompt: a small worn brass plaque on a bench's back with its inscription rendered as unreadable shapes, no words

panels.name: Plaque

panels.composition: Tier 3: the seawall's long curve from the bench, nobody. Held.

image.prompt: a long curving concrete seawall seen from a bench with nobody on it, no words

panels.name: Wall

art.line: razor-sharp, confident brush and ink; pristine perspective; crisp silhouettes; zero crosshatch in close-ups
art.palette: dailies: black ink, one spot tone at most. Sundays: wet-on-wet — gray-green moss, fog, rusted tin, bruised dusk
art.paper: bristol for dailies; 140 lb Arches cold-press for Sundays
